description: Frozen output of the Python Fourier radial filter (basis/filtering.py, numpy + scipy spherical_jn) taken on 2026-10-30 before it was ported to Rust. Inputs: PAW-LCAO lda-sr pseudo waves (first valence state of each channel l <= 2; H, C, O, Si stored, Cu, Ag, Au, Pt read from the library and checked against input_fingerprint), a diffuse function, and r^l exp(-a r^2) on three meshes. Outputs: a fingerprint for every case, the whole array where output_key is set.
